note: A four-view of the Tiger I in its mid production, 1222 by 777 px: the front at the top left, the left side with the nose left at the top right, the rear under the front and the plan under the side with the nose left. No scale on the sheet. The side and the plan are taken off the 3.605 m of track on the ground, 327.5 px, which puts the length over the hull at the published 6.316 m; the front and the rear off the 3.56 m over the tracks. Pinned at the first road wheel on the ground.
